In this Season 3 opener, it's an all-out celebration of talent as 12 of the world's top body artists begin the competition for the title of best painter of the naked human form; Rebecca Romijn hosts; judges include RuPaul Charles.

Actress Jillian Rose Reed guest judges; the body artists must tackle the difficult camouflage challenge, blending their naked models into intricate backgrounds; for one artist, what seems like child's play becomes an important lesson.

Make-up artist and internet sensation Kandee Johnson guest judges; working in their first partnered challenge allows the body artists to see another side of their competitors as they paint their naked models in both 2-D and 3-D poses.

The remaining artists are joined by nine fabulous drag queens, all vying to be crowned the first-ever Miss Skin Wars through competing in body-painted swimwear and a more personal painted costume design; judges include RuPaul Charles.
